verse.verse_1: By the sun and his morning bright-ness,
verse.verse_2: By the moon, when she followeth him,
verse.verse_3: By the day when it glorifieth him.
verse.verse_4: By the night; when it envelopeth him,
verse.verse_5: By the heaven and Him Who builded it,
verse.verse_6: By the earth and Him Who spread it forth,
verse.verse_7: By the soul and Him Who propertioned it,
verse.verse_8: And inspired it with the wickedness thereof and the piety thereof,
verse.verse_9: Surely blissful is he who hath cleansed, it,
verse.verse_10: And miserable is he who hath buried it.
verse.verse_12: What time the greatest wretch of them rose up.
verse.verse_13: Then the apostle of Allah said Unto them: beware of the she-camel of Allah and her drink.
verse.verse_14: Then they belied him, and they hamstrung her; wherefore their Lord overwhelmed them for their crime, and made it equal.
verse.verse_15: And He feared not the consequence thereof
